status: interaction calibration; frozen before first run
task_suite: Silo-Bench Global Max; one two-agent Level-I instance
decoding: greedy; local Transformers; 256 token response cap; four rounds maximum
interaction_scaffold: Coordination rules: use send_message with the other agent's ID, never your own. Compute and send only the local information needed. When a received message gives enough information to answer, immediately call submit_result with the task's required answer. Do not repeat a message or poll for messages after receiving the needed information. Every agent must submit a final answer.

conditions.concise_nl_scaffold: When sending a message, use one short, direct plain-English sentence. Include only exact task-relevant findings and values; omit greetings and explanation that does not change the answer.

intervention_control: no_communication: Silo send_message action disabled; no communication scaffold injected
limitations: One fixed task and one small open model make this interaction calibration only.
The scaffold is an explicit prompt intervention; its repeated input tokens are counted.
The concise natural-language arm retains the same scaffold so only sender phrasing is changed.
No result supports a general language or protocol superiority claim.
